description:
Resolve edition+version → HOW to obtain Odoo and the EXACT artifact.

    Community is fetchable automatically. Enterprise is licence-gated (no git
    without a partnership), so this returns `requires_human: true` with precise
    instructions: what .deb to download, from where, and where to place it - the
    provisioning step will then verify and continue. Pure logic, no ssh.
name: odoo_versions
